Aparna Bharti 
Data Governance & Regulatory Compliance Analyst 
Pune, Maharashtra, India  |  +91 9753285271 |  aparnabhrt@gmail.com 
LinkedIn Profile 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Data Governance and Regulatory Compliance professional with 6 years of experience in designing risk control frameworks, leading 
internal audits, and ensuring data quality, accuracy, and regulatory adherence across finance, FMCG, education, international trade, 
and M&A. Skilled in applying GAAP, IFRS, and COSO frameworks to assess internal controls, identify discrepancies, and strengthen 
governance practices. Experience in conducting risk assessments, managing UAT for cybersecurity and compliance integration, and 
translating governance findings into actionable reporting for leadership. Combines analytical rigor (Excel, Power BI, SQL, Collibra) 
with cross-functional stakeholder management to embed governance and compliance into business-critical processes. Experienced 
in mentoring analysts and training teams on audit, quality, and compliance standards. 
CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS 
• Data Governance & Regulatory Compliance: Data Governance Frameworks, Regulatory Compliance, GAAP, IFRS, COSO 
Framework, Internal Audits, Risk Assessment & Risk Control Frameworks, Data Quality & Integrity Assurance 
• Data Analysis & BI Tools: Excel (Formulas, Pivot Tables), Power BI, Basic SQL, Dashboard Development, KPI Tracking, Collibra, 
and Predictive Analysis (Based on the project requirements) 
• Market & Financial Research: M&A Data Analysis, Competitor Benchmarking, Valuation Trends, Market Intelligence, Economic & 
Demand Forecasting 
• Risk & Process Controls: Internal Controls Assessment, UAT for Cybersecurity & Compliance Integration, Workflow Automation, 
Process Re-engineering, Operational Efficiency 
• Stakeholder & Project Support: Stakeholder Engagement, Client & Management Reporting, Documentation, Cross-Functional 
Collaboration, Project Delivery Support 
• Leadership & Training: Mentoring Analysts, Training Teams on Audit & Quality Standards, Knowledge Sharing 
• Technical Proficiency: MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Basic SQL, Basic Power BI, Basic Agile Framework, Basic 
Collibra 
• Soft Skills:  Strategic Problem-Solving, Effective Communication, Report Writing, Collaboration 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

collaboration with the risk and compliance team.

clients.
